"Oh Father" is a song recorded by American singer Madonna for her fourth studio album Like a Prayer (1989).
It was released as the fourth single from the album on October 24, 1989, by Sire Records.
The song was not released as a single in most European territories until December 27, 1995, when it appeared on the 1995 ballads compilation Something to Remember.
